content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to connect an analog value from the web server to an Excel file. What is the recommended approach?
It is not possible to directly link an analog value from the web server to Excel. You can only transfer data from the [product_name] to Excel using the [product_name] Access Tool.
Thank you for your response. In the [product_name] Access Tool, is there a way to retrieve data every hour rather than every 60 seconds?
No, adjusting beyond 60 seconds is not possible. The maximum interval supported is 60 seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring methods to automate the export of analog values from a web server to Excel but find no direct integration. They learn that exporting data is only possible through the [product_name] Access Tool, which restricts the minimum interval for data collection to 60 seconds. These limitations hinder flexibility and automation capabilities for users wanting to log data at longer intervals.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a solution to periodically record analog values from the web server into Excel and wish to configure custom data logging intervals, ideally up to every hour.
